blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. Same-family transfer exceeds different-family transfer, family residuals weaken once globally shared heads are removed, and subtype-specific searches repeatedly rediscover many global heads. Clean-completion and context-use probes further suggest that this shared intervention can reduce harmful copying while preserving ordinary relation completion and simple in-context abilities. Our findings provide a more precise perspective on contextual entrainment and its mitigation: harmful context following is not best addressed by searching for isolated relation-specific circuits, but by using heterogeneous attack prompts to reveal reusable intervention targets whose effects are shaped by semantic relation structure.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型依靠即时上下文来进行内文学习,遵循格式,并适应当地证据. 然而,这种能力也引起了强烈性的关注:模型在回答后期的询问时可能会再利用早期上下文中无关的符号. 先前的工作将这种行为确定为上下文入内并找到其衰减的注意力头,认为这些头主要是任务或关系所特有的. 但是,环境内涵背后的机制是真正被关系所隔离的,还是有关系条件的搜索可以回收跨关系共享的可重复使用的组件? 我们利用19个语法语义亚型的实事求是关系 - 完成的提示, 找出了注意力头, 他们的膨胀会减少内涵, 同族家庭转移超过同族家庭转移,一旦全球共享头被移除后,家族残余被削弱,分型特异性搜索反复地重新发现许多全球头. 清洁补全和上下文使用探测器进一步表明,这种共享干预可以减少有害的复制,同时保留普通的连接补全和简单的内文本能力. 我们的研究结果提供了更精确的关于内在环境及其缓解的视角:后续有害环境不是通过寻找孤立的关联特定线路,而是通过使用异质攻击来揭示可重复使用的干预目标,其影响由语义关系结构所决定。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models exhibit a wide range of context-dependent behaviors: they follow instructions, infer task formats from demonstrations, maintain discourse entities, and answer questions based on prompt-local evidence ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Olsson et al., 2022 ) . These abilities, often grouped under in-context learning, entail a sensitivity to previous tokens.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型表现出了广泛的依上下文的行为:它们遵循指令,从演示中推断出任务格式,维持会话实体,并基于即时-局部证据回答问题(Brown等,2020;Olsson等,2022). 这些能力往往被归为文中学习,因而对以前的符号具有敏感性。

blocks.en:
This matters in settings where models must reason over long or heterogeneous inputs, including retrieval-augmented generation, long-context question answering, and tool-augmented interaction ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Yoran et al., 2024 ; Cuconasu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) .
In such settings, irrelevant context is not always random noise: it can provide structured cues that models incorporate into later predictions. Cheng et al. (2025) make this concern concrete through hallucinations in irrelevant-contexts, showing that models can combine abstract class cues with features drawn from the query or context, producing systematic but unreliable answers.
Our setting studies a token-level version of this problem: the distractor sentence is factually true for another subject, but its answer token becomes misleading evidence for a later, structurally parallel query.
blocks.zh:
在模型必须说明长期或不同输入理由的环境下,这一点很重要,包括检索式生成、长文本问题回答和工具式交互(Shi等,2023;Yoran等,2024;Cuconasu等,2024;Wu等,2024;Cheng等,2025)。
在这种情况下,不相关的上下文并不总是随机的噪音:它可以提供结构化的提示,使模型融入后期预测. 程等编. (2025年)通过不相干文字中的幻觉来使这种关注变得具体,表明模型可以将抽象的类提示与从查询或上下文中抽取的特征结合起来,产生系统而不可靠的答案.
我们的设定研究了这个问题的象征级版本:对另一个主体来说,分散分心的句子事实上是真实的,但是它的答案符号成为了日后结构平行查询的误导证据.

blocks.en:
This token-level route is closely related to contextual entrainment .
Following Niu et al. (2025) , we use this term for cases where tokens that appear earlier in the prompt become more likely to be generated later, even when they do not answer the current query.
For example: The capital of Japan is Tokyo. The capital of China is can increase the probability of the distractor token Tokyo , even though the correct answer is Beijing . The first sentence is true, and the repeated relation frame makes the earlier city name immediately available at the second answer position, where it competes with the correct continuation.
blocks.zh:
这个符号级的路线与背景内涵密切相关.
在Niu等人(2025年)之后,我们使用这个术语来表示在提示中较早出现的指使物在以后更有可能生成的情况,即使它们不回答当前的询问.
例如: 日本首都为东京. 尽管正确的答案是北京, 第一句是真实的,再三的关系框架使得更早的城市名在第二个接应位置即刻可以使用,与正确的续作相竞争.

blocks.en:
Recent mechanistic work has begun to localize this behavior inside transformer models. Niu et al. (2025) identify attention heads whose ablation reduces contextual entrainment and argue that the recovered head sets are largely task- or relation-specific. They noticed that there existed overlapping attention heads in the result of different relations. However, what this overlap reflects remains unclear.
Related work on knowledge conflict, however, shows that head-level interventions can sometimes generalize across relations and prompt formats ( Jin et al., 2024 ) .
This distinction matters for both interpretation and mitigation.
If entrainment heads are isolated relation-specific mechanisms, then contextual entrainment is organized into many narrow circuits, and mitigating it may require searching separately for each relation.
If relation-conditioned searches instead recover overlapping shared components, then apparent task specificity may reflect how a reusable context-following mechanism is selected under different data slices.
This leaves an open question: when a head set is discovered from a single relation, is it an isolated relation-specific mechanism, or a mixture of components with different scopes?
blocks.zh:
近期的机械工作已经开始将这种行为在变压器模型内部本地化. 牛等编. (2025) 确定减少环境内涵的注意力主管,并论证回收后的头套主要是任务或关系特异性的. 他们注意到,不同关系导致的注意力重叠。 然而,这种重叠所反映的情况仍不清楚。
然而,关于知识冲突的相关工作表明,头级干预有时可以泛指各种关系和迅速的形式(Jin等人,2024年)。
这种区分对解释和缓解都很重要。
如果排入头是孤立的关系特异性机制,那么背景的排入被组织成许多狭长的回路,而缓解它可能需要单独搜索每个关系.
如果以关系为条件的搜索可以回收重叠的共享组件,那么明显的任务特殊性可以反映在不同数据片下如何选择可重复使用的上下文跟踪机制。
这留下了一个未解的问题:当一个头集从单一的关系中被发现时,它是孤立的关系特定机制,还是不同范围组件的混合物?

blocks.en:
This question gives a head-level complement to Cheng et al. (2025) : if irrelevant context systematically shapes factual predictions, we ask whether the interventions that reduce this sensitivity are relation-specific or shared across relations. We hypothesize that relation-conditioned searches recover mixtures of shared and relation-sensitive components.
Rather than treating each relation-specific search result as a separate module, we ask whether these head sets contain components that operate at different levels of generality.
We refer to this as a mixed-circuit account of contextual entrainment.
This account makes different predictions from two simpler alternatives.
If entrainment-related heads are purely relation-specific, a head set found on one subtype should transfer little beyond that subtype.
If they are fully general, semantic relatedness should not affect transfer.
The mixed-circuit account predicts the middle case: strongest transfer to the same subtype, weaker but positive transfer within the same semantic family, and weakest transfer across unrelated families.
blocks.zh:
这个问题为程等(2025年)提供了头级补充:如果不相关的上下文系统地塑造了事实预测,我们询问降低这种敏感性的干预是针对关系还是跨关系共享的. 我们假设这种有关联条件的搜索可以回收共享和关系敏感组件的混合物。
我们不把每个针对关系的搜索结果作为一个单独的模块来处理,而是询问这些头集是否包含在不同通性级别运行的组件.
我们将此称为背景内涵的混合电路叙述。
这一说法从两个更简单的替代品中得出了不同的预测.
如果与内分泌相关的头部纯粹是关系特异性的,那么在一个子类型上发现的头集就应该小幅地转移到该子类型之外.
如果完全笼统,语义关联性不应影响转移.
混合电路账户预测了中间情况:最强转会到同一种子类型,在同一语义家族内部的转会较弱但正转会,而互不相干家族之间的转会最弱.

blocks.en:
We test this hypothesis on a controlled lexical-semantic benchmark with 19 relation subtypes grouped into Association, Attribute, Part–Whole, and Taxonomy.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , each clean relation-completion prompt is paired with an attacked prompt that prepends a true but irrelevant parallel fact from the same subtype.
The answer token in this prepended fact serves as the distractor: it appears in the immediate context, but it is not the correct continuation for the later query.
This lets us isolate prompt-local token reuse without introducing an explicit false statement about the queried subject.
We then search for entrainment-related heads and evaluate how the resulting interventions transfer across same-subtype, same-family, different-family, and mixed-relation conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个受控制的语法语义基准来测试这个假说,它有19个关系子类型,它们被归为协会、属性、Part-Whole和分类学。
如图1所显示的,每个干净的关系-补全快递与被攻击的快递对齐,该快递会预先从同一个子类型中得出一个真实但无关的平行事实.
这个被预想的事实中的答案符号充当了分心者:它出现在了即时上下文中,但它并不是后期查询的正确续作.
这样,我们就可以隔离迅速的本地符号再利用,而无需对被询问对象提出明显的虚假声明。
然后,我们寻找与排入有关的头部,并评估由此产生的干预措施如何在同一种亚型、同家庭、不同家庭和混合关系条件之间转移。

blocks.en:
We make three contributions.
First, we identify a reusable global intervention component embedded in relation-conditioned head sets, connecting cross-relation transfer with the repeated rediscovery of shared heads.
Second, we provide converging intervention evidence for a mixed-circuit account through comparisons of global, family, and subtype circuits, global-head exclusion, and approximately additive combinations of shared and residual components.
Third, we examine the practical consequences of search scope: in our primary-model experiments, mixed-relation search identifies interventions that reduce factual-distractor entrainment while better preserving clean external relation completion than the evaluated subtype-specific intervention.
blocks.zh:
我们作出了三项贡献。
首先,我们确定一个可重复使用的全球干预部分,嵌入了具有关联条件的头套,将交叉关系转移与共享头的反复再发现联系起来.
第二,我们通过比较全球、家族和亚型电路、全球电头排除以及共享和剩余组件的大约添加剂组合,为混合电路账户提供一致的干预证据。
第三,我们审查搜索范围的实际后果:在我们的主要模型实验中,混合关系搜索确定了能够减少事实障碍入内分泌的干预措施,同时比评估的子类型特定干预措施更好地维护清洁的外部关系完成.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LLMs are highly sensitive to prompt context, and prior work shows that irrelevant or misleading evidence can substantially alter model outputs, especially in retrieval-augmented generation and long-context question answering ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Yoran et al., 2024 ; Cuconasu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . Cheng et al. (2025) further show that irrelevant contextual cues can induce structured hallucinations through class-based misgeneralization. Niu et al. (2025) formalize contextual entrainment : tokens that appear earlier in the prompt are more likely to be generated later, even when they are random or semantically irrelevant. They identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and emphasize relation specificity, while also observing some cross-relation functional overlap.Our study examines how such overlap is organized into reusable shared and relation-sensitive intervention components.
blocks.zh: LLMS对即时上下文高度敏感,而先前的研究表明,无关或误导性的证据可以大大改变模型输出,特别是在检索生成和长文本问题回答中(Shi等,2023;Yoran等,2024;Cuconasu等,2024;Wu等,2024). Cheng等 (2025)进一步表明,不相关的上下文提示可以通过基于阶级的误通来诱发结构化的幻觉. 牛等编. (2025年) 正式地将上下文内分泌: 早期出现在快件中的活字符号更可能在后期生成,即使这些符号是随机的或与集合无关. 它们找出了注意力头,其衰减会减少内分泌,强调关系的特殊性,同时也观察到一些交叉关系功能重叠. 我们的研究审查了如何将这种重叠分为可重复使用的共同和对关系敏感的干预部分。

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability has shown that attention heads can implement identifiable computations, including induction-like copying, name moving, and task-specific circuits ( Olsson et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Induction heads are especially relevant here because they implement a form of pattern completion: continuations from earlier contexts are reused at later matching positions ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . Related work on knowledge conflict further suggests that attention heads can mediate competition between parametric memory and external context, and that head-level interventions can generalize across relations and prompt formats ( Jin et al., 2024 ) . Together, these findings make it plausible that factual-distractor prompts share a reusable context-following component even when their surface relations differ.
blocks.zh: 机械解释性表明,关注头可以实施可识别的计算,包括感应式复制,名称移动,以及任务特有电路(Olsson等,2022;Wang等,2023). 在此,上岗头尤其具有相关性,因为它们执行一种模式完成形式:在以后的匹配位置上重复使用早先背景的延续(Olsson等人,2022年)。 有关知识冲突的相关工作还表明,关注者可以调解参数记忆和外部背景之间的竞争,而头级干预可以泛指各种关系和即时格式(Jin等人,2024年)。 这些调查结果加在一起,可以认为,事实传播的诱因即使其表面关系不同,也具有可重复使用的背景。

blocks.en: A growing line of work uses activation patching, pruning, and differentiable masks to identify causally relevant components in language models. Yu et al. (2025) use Gumbel-Sigmoid masking for gradient-based joint computation-graph pruning in language-model circuit discovery, building on continuous relaxations of discrete variables and sparse stochastic gates ( Maddison et al., 2017 ; Jang et al., 2017 ; Louizos et al., 2018 ) . Niu et al. (2025) apply a related Gumbel-Sigmoid head-search framework to contextual entrainment. These methods make it possible to move beyond descriptive transfer patterns and ask whether head sets discovered from individual relations reflect isolated mechanisms or repeatedly recovered shared structure.
blocks.zh: 不断增长的工作线采用活化补丁,活化和相异口罩来识别语言模型中因果相关的组件. Yu等 (2025年)在语言-模型电路发现中利用Gumbel-Sigmoid掩码来进行以梯度为基础的联合计算-图穿透,并借助于离散变量和稀疏的花纹门的持续放松(Madison等,2017年;Jang等,2017年;Louizos等,2018年). Niu等人(2025年)将相關的Gumbel-Sigmoid头部搜索框架应用于上下文入内. 这些方法使得有可能超越描述性转移模式,并询问从个别关系中发现的头集是反映孤立的机制还是反复恢复的共享结构.

blocks.en: Broader mechanistic work argues that model mechanisms can be distributed, overlapping, and partly redundant rather than cleanly modular ( Elhage et al., 2022 ; McGrath et al., 2023 ) . This matters for head search: low overlap between recovered head sets is not, by itself, evidence for isolated task-specific mechanisms. At the same time, work on relation representations suggests that factual relations are systematically organized in model states ( Hernandez et al., 2024 ) . Together, these perspectives motivate our question: whether relation-conditioned causal searches recover narrow local effects, or broader shared structure with relation-sensitive modulation.
blocks.zh: 更广义的机械化工作认为,模型机制可以分布,重叠,部分冗余而非清洁模块化(Elhage等,2022;McGrath等,2023.). 这一点需要头部搜索:回收头套的重叠程度低,这本身并不是孤立的任务特定机制的证据。 与此同时,关于关系陈述的工作表明,事实关系是按模范国家系统组织的(Hernandez等,2024年)。 这些观点共同激发了我们的问题:以关系为条件的因果关系搜索是否恢复了狭隘的局部效果,还是具有关系敏感调制的更广泛的共享结构.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
The results test whether relation-conditioned head searches identify isolated relation-specific circuits or mixed circuits with shared components.
At first glance, searches on different lexical-semantic subtypes return different top- K K heads, and these differences matter for transfer.
The key result, however, is that this surface-level task dependence masks a shared structure: relation-conditioned searches repeatedly include a global component, with family- and subtype-level variation layered around it.
blocks.zh:
结果检验了关联条件的头部搜索是否识别出孤立的关系特有电路或带有共享组件的混合电路.
乍一看,对不同的词典-语义子类型的搜索返回了不同的上-K头,这些差异对于转移很重要.
然而,关键的结果是,这种地表级任务依赖性掩盖了一个共享结构:关系条件的搜索反复包含一个全局组件,其周围有家庭和子类型级的变异层.

blocks.en: We organize this pattern using the mixed-circuit hypothesis. For a subtype of relation r r , a set of heads recovered by relation-specific search can be functionally viewed as C r ≈ G + F fam ⁡ ( r ) + S r + ϵ , C_{r}\approx G+F_{\mathrm{fam}(r)}+S_{r}+\epsilon, where G G is a reusable global context-following component, F fam ⁡ ( r ) F_{\mathrm{fam}(r)} is semantic-family modulation, S r S_{r} is subtype-specific structure, and ϵ \epsilon captures template, optimizer, or factual-completion idiosyncrasies. This decomposition is not intended to be a strict linear factorization of head effects; rather, it provides a guide to interpret transfer, residual, and overlap patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们利用混合电路假设来组织这个模式. 对于关系r的子类型,通过关系特异性搜索恢复的一组头可以被功能上看成C r + G + F fam + r (r) + S r + → , C_{r}\ 相近 G+F_{\-mathrm{fam}(r)}+-S_{r}+\-epsilon,其中G为可再使用的全球上下文组件;F fa-fam⁡ (r)F_{\-mathrm{fam}(r)}为语义-家族调制;S r-r S_{r}为子类型特有结构;和\ep\epsilon捕获模板,优化器,或实事求是地完成异构. 这种分解并不是为了对头部效应进行严格的线性分解;相反,它为解释转移,剩余和重叠模式提供了指南.

blocks.en: We first verify that the recovered head sets have genuine causal effects on factual-distractor entrainment and that transfer is graded by semantic relatedness (Figure 2 ). We then use transfer, residualization, head overlap, additive intervention tests, and clean-capability probes to distinguish isolated task-specific circuits from the mixed-circuit account.

blocks.en: 4.1 Transfer Is Graded by Semantic Relatedness
blocks.zh: 4.1 转让按语义关联性分类

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes this structure: the transfer matrix falls between two extremes—isolated relation-specific circuits and fully universal heads.
blocks.zh: 图2概括了这一结构:转移矩阵介于两个极端——孤立关系特定电路和完全通用的电头之间。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows a graded pattern: different-family transfer is weakest, same-family transfer is stronger, and same-subtype transfer is strongest. After target-centering, different-family transfer is below the target average ( − 0.054 -0.054 ), same-family transfer is above it ( + 0.069 +0.069 ), and same-subtype transfer is much larger ( + 0.512 +0.512 ). This hierarchy remains significant under clustered bootstrap, cell-level tests, and family-label permutation controls; full statistics are reported in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Relation-specific searches therefore do not recover isolated subtype modules, but neither do they recover a fully relation-agnostic circuit. Semantic family and exact subtype both modulate transfer.
blocks.zh: 因此,关系特异性搜索无法回收孤立的子类型模块,但也不能回收一个完全关系不可知的电路. 语义上的家庭和准确的子类型 两种调性转移。

blocks.en: 4.2 Family Effects Are Built on Global Shared Heads
blocks.zh: 4.2 家庭影响是对全球共同领导的影响

blocks.en: The graded transfer pattern suggests that semantic relatedness modulates transfer, but it does not by itself determine whether this structure reflects family-specific modules or variations around a shared mechanism. We therefore compare four circuit constructions: circuits searched on a balanced mixture of all active subtypes ( global-shared ), circuits searched only within the target family ( family-shared ), circuits searched on the exact target subtype ( subtype-specific ), and family rankings after removing global-shared top- K K heads ( family residual ).
blocks.zh: 分级的转移模式表明语义相关性会调节转移,但它本身并不决定这种结构是反映家庭特有的模块还是围绕一个共享机制而变化. 因此,我们比较了四种电路构造:在所有活性子类型(全球共享)的平衡混合物上搜索的电路,只在目标家族(家庭共享)内搜索的电路,在精确的目标子类型(子类型特定)上搜索的电路,以及删除全球共享上-K头(家族剩余)后的家庭排名.

The global-shared circuit is the strongest aggregate intervention, with average recovery 1.464 \mathbf{1.464} , while family-shared circuits remain effective but weaker on average ( 1.306 \mathbf{1.306} ). Thus, same-family transfer is real, but much of this family structure is organized around a reusable global core rather than independent family modules.

blocks.en: 4.3 Relation-Specific Searches Rediscover the Global Core
blocks.zh: 4.3 联系-特定搜索

blocks.en: A strong global circuit could still be an artifact of mixed-relation search. If so, it would not need to appear inside relation-specific circuits. The mixed-circuit account predicts the opposite: the same global heads should be repeatedly rediscovered when searching on individual subtypes.
blocks.zh: 强大的全球电路仍然可能是混合关系搜索的产物. 如果是的话,它就不需要出现在关系特定电路内. 混合电路账户预言相反:同样的全局头在搜索单个子类型时应当被反复地重新发现.

blocks.en: This prediction is borne out in the overlap statistics. Global-shared circuits overlap with family-shared circuits by 40.25 heads on average, compared with 6.25 expected by random overlap. They overlap with subtype-specific circuits by 32.84 heads on average, and 75 of the 80 global-shared heads appear in at least one subtype-specific top- K K circuit. The global circuit is therefore not separate from relation-specific circuits; it is largely made of heads that narrower searches also select.
blocks.zh: 重叠的统计数字证实了这一预测。 全球共享电路与家族共享电路相重叠,平均为40.25个头,而随机重叠预计为6.25个. 它们与亚型特有电路平均相重叠为32.84个头,80个全局共享电头中的75个在至少一个亚型特有上-克电路中出现. 因此,全局电路并非与关系特有电路相分离;它主要是由更窄的搜索也选择的头来构成的.

blocks.en: Rediscovery frequency is itself predictive of causal effect. If we rank heads only by how often they appear in subtype-specific top- K K circuits, the resulting frequency-defined global heads recover much of the global-search circuit. At K = 80 K=80 , they reach recovery 1.350 1.350 , close to the global-search recovery 1.464 1.464 , while rarely rediscovered heads recover only 0.082 0.082 (Table 3 ). This provides head-level evidence that G G is already embedded in the subtype circuits C r C_{r} .

blocks.en: 4.4 The Mixed-Circuit Decomposition Predicts Intervention Effects

blocks.en: The mixed-circuit account treats a relation-conditioned head set as a combination of a global component, a family-level residual, and a subtype-level residual.

blocks.en:
For each target subtype, we construct disjoint head sets corresponding to the global

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results refine the task-specific interpretation of contextual entrainment heads proposed by Niu et al. (2025) . Consistent with prior work, searches on different relation tasks do not return identical head sets. This variability is not surprising: transformer computations are often distributed and redundant, with multiple components able to support overlapping functions or compensate for one another under intervention ( Elhage et al., 2022 ; McGrath et al., 2023 ) . The key question is therefore not whether different tasks select exactly the same heads, but whether the selected heads are functionally isolated. Our results suggest that they are not. Relation-conditioned searches repeatedly contain a global component that transfers across semantic families, while family and subtype structure modulate this shared component.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果完善了由Niu等人(2025年)提出的针对具体任务对周围排入头的解释。 与先前的工作一致,不同关系任务的搜索不会返回相同的头集. 这种可变性不足为奇:变压器的计算常常是分布和冗余的,在干预下有多个组件能够支持相重叠的函数或相互补偿(Elhage等,2022;McGrath等,2023.). 因此,关键问题不是不同的任务是否选择完全相同的头,而是被选中的头是否在功能上孤立. 我们的结果表明,它们不是。 关系条件化的搜索反复包含一个跨语义家族传输的全球组件,而家庭和子类型结构则会调节这个共享组件.

blocks.en: Contextual entrainment is behaviorally general: models often reuse prompt-local structure across tasks and relations ( Olsson et al., 2022 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) . However, this behavioral generality does not by itself imply a shared circuit-level intervention. The same vulnerability could have been implemented by largely separate relation-specific head sets, in which case a circuit found for one relation would transfer little beyond that relation. Our results show instead that relation-conditioned searches repeatedly recover a strong relation-general component. Semantic family and subtype structure still shape the effect, but mainly by modulating this shared component rather than replacing it with separate modular circuits. Thus, the significance of the global core is mechanistic: apparent relation specificity partly reflects different uses of a reusable context-following substrate.

blocks.en: Single-relation search entangles two components: heads that reduce distractor copying and heads involved in normal relation completion. This explains why subtype-specific circuits are strong but have larger side effects. Heterogeneous search changes the selection pressure: a head is favored only if its ablation consistently reduces distractor entrainment across different relations. The resulting global circuit better preserves ordinary completion while targeting harmful context following.
blocks.zh: 单关系搜索会缠绕两个部分:减少分心器复制头和涉及正常关系完成头. 这解释了亚型特异性电路之所以强而副作用较大的原因. 异相搜索会改变选择压力:只有当头部的衰竭持续地减少不同关系之间的分心分泌时,才会得到偏好. 由此而来的全球电路更好地保存了普通的完成,同时针对随后的有害环境。

The global component also suggests a practical direction for settings with heterogeneous factual context. In retrieval-augmented generation, multi-document question answering, dialogue history, and tool-augmented agent traces, the model may see true facts that are useful locally but irrelevant to the current query. A mitigation method therefore cannot simply suppress context use, since factual grounding is the purpose of these systems. Prior relation-specific interventions may be difficult to deploy in such settings, where a single context can mix many relation types and factual roles. search identifies reusable interventions that reduce
factual-distractor copying while largely preserving clean
completion.
These findings motivate future evaluation of shared interventions
in RAG and long-context tasks.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: By analyzing entrainment across lexical-semantic relations, we show that context following in LLMs is neither fully relation-specific nor fully relation-general. Head-level intervention and transfer analyses reveal mixed circuits: a reusable global component supports broad context following, while semantic-family and subtype structure shape how this component is used in particular relations. These findings challenge the view that entrainment-related heads form isolated relation-specific modules. Apparent task specificity instead emerges from overlapping shared and relation-sensitive components. For mitigation, this suggests starting from heterogeneous attack data to identify broad reusable interventions, while using relation-specific searches for fine-grained specialization.
blocks.zh: 通过分析各种语法-语义关系的内涵,我们表明,在法学硕士课程中遵循的背景既不是完全具体的关系,也不是完全一般的关系。 头级干预和转移分析揭示出混合电路:可重复使用的全球元件支持后面的广泛上下文,而语义-家族和子类型结构则决定了该元件在特定关系中使用的方式. 这些调查结论对以下观点提出了质疑,即与排入有关的头部构成孤立的与关系相关的模块。 明显的任务特殊性来自重叠的共享和对关系敏感的组件。 就缓解而言,这意味着从各种攻击数据入手,确定广泛的可重复使用的干预措施,同时利用针对具体关系的搜索来进行精细的专业化。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. LLaMA-3.1-8B serves as our primary case study, and corresponding cross-model results for Mistral-7B and Qwen2.5-7B are reported in Appendix C . Our benchmark is also controlled: prompts use relation-completion templates, and answers are restricted to single tokens so that gold-versus-distractor margins are directly comparable. This design improves interpretability, but it leaves open whether the same mixed-circuit structure appears in more natural long-context or retrieval settings. We did not conduct our experiments using larger LMs due to resource limitations.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 LLaMA-3.1-8B是我们的主要案例研究,附录C报告了Mistral-7B和Qun2.5-7B的相应跨模型结果。 我们的基准也被控制: 提示使用关系- 补全模板, 答案被限制在单个符号上, 这样金相比差值可以直接比较 。 这种设计提高了可解释性,但无论相同的混合电路结构在更自然的长文本或检索设置中出现,都留下了开口. 由于资源的限制,我们没有使用较大的LMs进行实验。

blocks.en: Our conclusions are also conditional on valid attacked cases. This filtering is appropriate for studying harmful entrainment, since recovery is meaningful only when the factual distractor actually weakens the gold-over-distractor margin. However, it does not characterize all uses of context following, including cases where context helps the model answer correctly. Finally, head ablation identifies causally useful components, but it does not fully specify the internal algorithm by which the model resolves competition between the gold answer and the distractor. Future work should combine head-level interventions with activation patching or representation-level analyses, and should evaluate stability over more seeds and broader prompt distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们的结论也以有效的攻击案件为条件。 这种过滤法适合研究有害的内分泌,因为只有在事实分泌物实际上会削弱出金的分泌物比分时,恢复才有意义. 但是,它并没有描述下文所有上下文的用途,包括上下文有助于正确回答模型的情况。 最后,头部衰减识别出因果有用的组件,但并没有完全指定模型通过何种内部算法解决了金答和分心器之间的竞争. 今后的工作应当将头级干预与激活补丁或代表级分析相结合,并应当评价更多种子的稳定性和更广泛的及时分发。

blocks.en: To test whether the global component is specific to zero ablation, we run a clean-to-attacked activation replacement intervention. For each valid attacked prompt, we first run the corresponding clean prompt and cache the selected heads’ final-position outputs. We then run the attacked prompt while replacing those same head outputs at the answer position with their clean-prompt activations. This intervention is less destructive than zero ablation and tests whether the selected heads carry attack-sensitive contextual signal.
blocks.zh: 为了测试全球成分是否为零衰竭所特有,我们运行一个从清洁到攻击的活化替代干预. 对于每个有效的被攻击的快件,我们首先运行相应的干净快件并缓存选定的头部最后位置输出. 然后,我们运行被攻击的快讯,同时用它们干净的即时活化来取代答案位置上相同的头输出. 这种干预的破坏性小于零减速并测试所选头部是否带有攻击敏感背景信号.

blocks.en: Figure 5 reports the results on 100 valid attacked cases, balanced across the four semantic families. Global-shared heads recover 60.4% of the attack-induced margin loss under activation replacement, with a raw margin increase of 1.40. Frequency-defined global heads show a similar effect, recovering 52.4% of the margin loss. By contrast, rare heads recover only 6.5%. The logit decomposition further distinguishes global heads from controls: global replacement both increases the gold logit and decreases the distractor logit, whereas rare and same-layer random heads reduce the gold logit. This supports the interpretation that the global component is not merely a zero-ablation artifact.
blocks.zh: 图5报告了100起有效攻击案件的结果,在四个语义家庭之间取得了平衡。 全球共享头在活化置换下回收了60.4%由攻击引起的边距损失,原始边距增加1.40. 频率定义的全局头部显示类似效果,收回52.4%的比值损失. 相形之下,稀有的头只恢复了6.5%. logit分解进一步区分了全局头和控件:全局替换既会增加金子对数,又会减少分心器对数,而稀有和同层随机头会减少金子对数. 这支持一种解释,即全球组成部分不仅仅是零缩小的文物。
